engineOverview.title: Everything You Need to Know About the Range Rover 204DTA Engine
paragraphs: The 204DTA is a 2.0-litre twin-turbocharged Ingenium inline-four diesel engine found across several modern Range Rover and Land Rover platforms. When considering replacement, verifying compatibility against your vehicle’s VIN, transmission type, and software calibration is critical. Range Rover Garage provides comprehensive supply, reconditioning, and professional fitting solutions to restore factory performance and longevity.

Choosing the right replacement begins with identifying your vehicle’s exact specification. Our team can help you check the engine code and discuss your repair, rebuild, or replacement options. Have your registration or VIN ready when requesting a quote so we can assess the requirements for your vehicle.

From initial assessment through to fitting and final checks, our workshop can guide you through the next steps for your 204DTA engine. Contact our specialists to discuss engine availability, compatibility, and the work required for your Range Rover or Land Rover.

engineProblems.title: Common Range Rover 204DTA Engine Problems
engineProblems.description: Early symptoms requiring specialist diagnosis. Prompt assessment helps prevent further internal component wear.

cards.title: Timing Chain Noise & Rattle
cards.description: Metallic slapping or ticking audible on cold start from the rear of the engine block can indicate chain elongation or hydraulic tensioner wear.

cards.title: Loss of Power & Restricted Mode
cards.description: A “Performance Restricted” dash warning may be associated with turbocharger actuator or boost control issues. Specialist testing can identify the cause.

cards.title: Starting Difficulties / Long Crank
cards.description: Extended cranking cycles or non-start events can be linked to common rail fuel pressure loss or injector return leakage.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Excessive Exhaust Smoke
cards.description: Blue or dense black tailpipe emissions under acceleration may indicate oil burning, turbo wear, or issues with the fuel and exhaust systems.

cards.title: Coolant or Oil Cross-Contamination
cards.description: Unexplained coolant loss or oil discoloration requires investigation of the cooling system, oil cooler, and possible internal leaks.

cards.title: Engine Warning Light / Fault Codes
cards.description: Persistent Check Engine lights can accompany timing synchronisation, oil pressure, or boost sensor faults. A diagnostic scan helps guide further testing.

cards.title: Engine Compatibility and Selection
cards.description: The 204DTA Ingenium variant features subtle differences across model years and body configurations, notably between transverse (Evoque, Discovery Sport) and longitudinal layouts (Velar, Discovery 5). Oil pans, turbo routing, and cooling pipes vary. Our engineering team reviews your vehicle’s VIN and registration details to confirm the mechanical and electronic match before engine preparation.

faq.description: Answers to common questions about 204DTA engine compatibility, replacement, reconditioning, and fitting. Share your registration or VIN for advice specific to your vehicle.

faqs.q: How do I confirm that a 204DTA engine fits my vehicle?
faqs.a: Send us your registration or VIN along with your engine code, if available. Our team will check your vehicle specification, installation layout, transmission, and electronic compatibility before recommending an engine.

faqs.q: Can I choose between a used, reconditioned, or rebuilt engine?
faqs.a: We can discuss these options based on your vehicle, budget, and the condition of your existing engine. Ask what inspections, replacement parts, testing, and warranty terms are included in the proposed option.

faqs.q: Can you supply the engine and fit it for me?
faqs.a: Contact us about engine supply or supply and fitting. Your quotation will confirm the proposed engine, installation work, fluids, ancillary parts, and any additional work required.

faqs.q: How much does a 204DTA engine replacement cost?
faqs.a: The price depends on the engine specification, condition, availability, and the work required. Send your vehicle details for a quotation that explains the included parts and labour.

faqs.q: Does a replacement engine come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine and service agreed. Confirm the duration, covered components, exclusions, and maintenance requirements in your written quotation before ordering.

faqs.q: Can you arrange collection or engine delivery?
faqs.a: Ask our team about collection and delivery options for your location. Availability, costs, and arrangements will be confirmed with your quotation.

faqs.q: How long will the replacement take?
faqs.a: Timing depends on engine availability, workshop scheduling, and any additional repairs identified during inspection. Our team will discuss the expected turnaround when assessing your vehicle.

workshopIntro.title: Specialist Care for Your Range Rover 204DTA Engine
workshopIntro.description: Whether you need an engine assessment, a replacement unit, or professional fitting, our team can help you understand the next steps. Share your registration or VIN to discuss compatibility, available options, and a quotation tailored to your vehicle.
paragraphs: Finding a suitable 204DTA engine starts with understanding your vehicle’s exact specification and the condition of its current powertrain. Engine code, model year, transmission, and installation layout all help determine the right approach. Our team can review your registration or VIN and discuss whether diagnosis, repair, rebuilding, or replacement is the appropriate next step.

When comparing engine options, look beyond the unit itself. Ask which components are included, what inspection and restoration work has been completed, and how the engine will be checked before installation. We can explain the proposed scope of work, discuss supply-only or fitting options, and identify any ancillary parts that need attention as part of your quotation.

Clear information makes it easier to plan your vehicle’s return to the road. Before work is agreed, discuss expected availability, workshop scheduling, collection or delivery arrangements, and the warranty terms attached to your chosen option.
